Markets in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 8 events

Flea markets, craft and design fairs, food markets and record or book sales that last a day or a weekend. Ideal for bargain hunters, collectors and anyone who likes to browse and meet the makers. The list is refreshed every week, so you can plan your weekend around it. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

  1. Winter Market Leidseplein

    Christmas Markets · Markets · Food · Drink

    When
    Mon 16 – Sun 22 Nov (daily), Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00; Sat & Sun 11:00–23:00
    Where
    Leidseplein & Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen, Amsterdam (Leidseplein, Centrum)
    Price
    Free entry; pay per stall
    Organiser
    IJsbaan Amsterdam

    Wooden chalets on Leidseplein and the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen selling Christmas decorations, gifts, cheese, oliebollen and hot snacks, with a mulled-wine tower and a big Christmas tree. Runs until 3 January.

    Details and tickets for Winter Market Leidseplein (organiser's site)

  2. Vintage, Brocante, Antiques, Art & Design Fair

    Markets · Fashion & Vintage · Art & Design

    When
    Fri 20 – Sun 22 Nov, Fri & Sat 11:00–18:00, Sun 11:00–17:00
    Where
    Posthoornkerk, Haarlemmerstraat 124-126, Amsterdam (Haarlemmerbuurt, Centrum)
    Price
    Free
    Organiser
    Stadsherstel Amsterdam

    About 35 dealers fill a beautifully restored church with vintage, brocante, antiques, art and design — three days of treasure-hunting on the Haarlemmerstraat.

    Details and tickets for Vintage, Brocante, Antiques, Art & Design Fair (organiser's site)

    Markets · Food · Regular

    Where
    Hoek Jacob Obrechtstraat / Johannes Verhulststraat, Amsterdam (Oud-Zuid)

  8. QRU flea market: last one of 2026

    Markets · Fashion & Vintage · Music · Regular

    Where

    Price
